name: Ladder: CoatlicueTimingConfigurationConnected
summary: CoatlicueTimingConfigurationConnectedMsg, wire 0x1be, type index 446, the second member of the client's CoatlicueClientMessages set to appear in the capture. A 76-byte server-to-client record whose 72-byte body is a 4-byte tag, 32 unnamed bytes and the same 36-byte run 0x40a carries. The capture sends it once, after 0x40a and before the self-identification record.
purpose: Tell the client the Coatlicue timing configuration is connected. The name comes from the type table, so what the record does to client state is not established; its place in the ladder is measured.

created_when: the client has accepted the registration response and is waiting for its identity
lifecycle.if_absent: unmeasured. The record is one of the three the capture sends before the self-identification record that this server did not send at all.

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): the type marker followed by the prefix varint be 06 = 446 = 0x1be, so the 72-byte body below starts at record offset 0x04.
